item.title: Resident Evil Lead Teases Series’ ‘Conclusion’ Coming In the Next 10 Years
item.description: Resident Evil is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year. Capcom's iconic horror series has been a foundational part of the survival horro genre, and it's still delivering amazing entries, such as this year's Resident Evil Requiem . Still, that doesn't mean it will be around forever. With remakes of past titles catching up to new mainline games, the series may be entering a new phase, which may bring about its conclusion.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4’s Multiplayer Is the Best Call of Duty Has Been in 7 Years
item.description: After two years of back-to-back Black Ops games, Modern Warfare 4 was always going to feel like a breath of fresh air. Even though the differences between the two series are subtle, the minor tweaks to movement, gunplay, and aesthetic are always noticeable to anyone who plays year in, year out. And I've always been a Modern Warfare kid at heart, from way back in 2007, when I lived and breathed Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare for a year straight. The last Call of Duty that truly captivated me was 2019's Modern Warfare .

item.title: How to get Tifa and Barrett's outfits in FFXIV
item.description: Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14 ' s event in the Keybound Brawlers , a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7 . Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7 -themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

item.title: Major 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' Game Finally Lives Up To The Hype
item.description: With its fantastic animation and incredible attention to detail, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game felt like it was destined for greatness. And perhaps the fighting game could have gone down as the best Avatar interactive experience ever made had it not been released in July 2026 without some key components promised in its marketing. But now, three months later, Avatar Legends looks like it might to live up to its original promise.

item.title: Discord's Massive New Change Will Shake Up The Entire Internet
item.description: The best and worst thing about Discord is that messages sent on its chat servers are ephemeral. On the one hand, it's nice to know that things said in a casual setting won't necessarily be plastered on the internet forever. On the other hand, Discord's temporality is frustrating when you need to find a critical piece of information . These defining characteristics for Discord are about to change — and the repercussions will be visible throughout the entire internet.

item.title: Lord of the Rings’ New Aragorn Actor Officially Opens up on Role’s Immense Pressure
item.description: It can't be easy taking over a role from an actor who so perfectly portrayed the character before. Yet that is exactly what Jamie Dornan (Fifty Shades of Grey , Once Upon a Time ) is preparing to do. He will play Aragorn in The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum , replacing Viggo Mortensen. Dornan admitted he's feeling the pressure.

item.title: How to open the Nameless Ruins chest in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: You're greeted with a sealed chest in Final Fantasy Resonance 's Nameless Ruins , and it's hard to miss, since there's a big statue right next to it. When you approach the chest, however, you get a riddle with little guidance as to what it means — and the statue next to you is of no use. Yet. You'll need to make some progress in this dungeon and complete a few steps in the right order to open the chest, but the prize inside is worth the hassle.

item.title: The Wolf Among Us Puts a Deliciously Dark Twist on Our Favorite Fairy Tales
item.description: 13 years after its release, the Telltale title is getting a remaster worth celebrating.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 Just Made 100% Completion Impossible With New Update
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has barely been out for a week, and players are already dealing with a change that could make 100% completion impossible. A new update to the game's Free-for-All mode has lowered the score limit below the number of kills required to earn a nuke, potentially locking completionists out of a major in-game achievement.

item.title: Epic Officially Confirms It’s 'Vibe Coding' Unreal Engine 6 and Future 'Fortnite' Updates
item.description: Epic continues to be all-in on AI. In a recent statement to This Week In Video Games , Epic’s executive VP of development Marcus Wassmer clarified the specifics around how the company is using AI for Unreal Engine 6, Fortnite , and just about everything else at the company.
